race.description: Myracehorse-The Wyong Horse Bundle Prov Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SONO IMMORTALE (1) raced handy on debut from the wide gate when he kept finding to secure second over 1300m at Hawkesbury. Can stalk the speed from the inside gate and get the better of these. SAVOONGA (5) best performance in five starts first-up when she raced on the pace for a game second to Sphere over 1250m at Newcastle. Has further upside and the extra trip suits. Leading contender. COMANCHE CHIEF (4) Wild Ruler gelding from Tirone Miss on debut for the Martino yard. Has shown ability at the trials and the blinkers go on, respect. CLASSIC TWO (7) has a fitness edge and rates an each-way chance.
